Title: Multi-Class Road User Detection With 3+1D Radar in the View-of-Delft Dataset
Main_Contribution: VoD dataset; 3+1D radar baseline; feature and temporal ablations
Main_Limitation: Sparse points; far-distance difficulty; occlusion; sensor-mounting differences
Potential_Gap: Distance/RCS/sparsity-aware detection is a candidate question and not a confirmed literature gap
Relation_to_Our_Work: Establishes the P001 radar-only detection baseline
